apps.subtitle: Receive, scan, decide, release, at your own pace
apps.localizedDescription: Sketches of being the pivot, in one app. Tap a door: Iron Filings (you never touch the ball; your teammates snap round you and the pressers follow you), Lighthouse (the scan is a beam; your memory is the map) or The Hole (a real moment with him taken out; StatsBomb open data fetched at run time). Swipe in from the left edge to come back. Working title.
